title: If, Will, Would, Were: Conditional vs Imaginary

vocabulary.meaning_en: used to say that one thing must happen before another can happen
vocabulary.example: If it rains, we will stay home.

vocabulary.meaning_en: depending on something else happening first
vocabulary.example: "If you study, you will pass" is conditional.

vocabulary.meaning_en: not real; only in your mind
vocabulary.example: "If I were a bird, I would fly" is imaginary.

vocabulary.meaning_en: used for the future and for real conditions
vocabulary.example: If you come, you will learn.

vocabulary.meaning_en: the past of will; used for imaginary situations
vocabulary.example: If I had time, I would help you.

vocabulary.meaning_en: past of be; in imaginary if-sentences we use were with all subjects
vocabulary.meaning_ar: كان (في جمل الافتراض مع كل الضمائر)
vocabulary.note_ar: If I were / If he were (وليس was في الأسلوب الصحيح)
vocabulary.note_en: If I were / If he were (not was, in correct style).
vocabulary.example: If he were here, he would help us.

vocabulary.meaning_en: news about films, TV and famous people
vocabulary.example: He reads the entertainment news every day.
If I paid attention, I would make fewer mistakes.

vocabulary.meaning_en: an opinion about what someone should do
vocabulary.example: "If I were you, I would rest" is advice.

fine_lines.title: if + will vs if + would
fine_lines.explanation_ar: if + المضارع ... will = شرط حقيقي ممكن (يجب أن يحدث شيء أولًا ليحدث الآخر). if + الماضي/were ... would = حالة متخيَّلة غير حقيقية الآن.
fine_lines.explanation_en: if + present ... will = a real, possible condition (one thing must happen first). if + past/were ... would = an imaginary situation, not real now.

examples.sentence: If you study hard, you will learn English well.
If I were smarter, I would buy the whole newspaper.

fine_lines.title: If I was vs If I were
fine_lines.explanation_ar: في الجمل المتخيَّلة نستخدم were مع كل الضمائر: If I were, If he were, If she were. كثيرون يقولون was في الكلام العادي، لكن were هي الصحيحة في القواعد.
fine_lines.explanation_en: In imaginary sentences we use were with every subject: If I were, If he were, If she were. Many people say was in casual speech, but were is the correct grammar.

examples.sentence: If I were you, I would call her.
If he were rich, he would travel the world.

expressions.phrase: If I were you, I would...
expressions.meaning_en: A common way to give advice.
expressions.example: If I were you, I would see a doctor.

expressions.phrase: If you come, you will learn.
expressions.example: If you come to class, you will learn.

expressions.meaning_en: A formal way to talk about an imaginary action.
expressions.example: If I were to come to your house, you would know about it.

grammar.title: Conditional: if + present, will + base verb
grammar.explanation_ar: if تعني أن شيئًا يجب أن يحدث أولًا. if + المضارع البسيط، ثم will + المصدر. هذا شرط حقيقي ممكن الحدوث.
grammar.explanation_en: If means one thing must happen first. if + present simple, then will + base verb. It is a real, possible condition.
examples: If you study hard, you will learn English well.
If he studies, he will be a good student.
If I read this paper, I will know all the news.

grammar.title: Imaginary: if + past (were), would + base verb
grammar.explanation_ar: if + الماضي (مع be نستخدم were لكل الضمائر)، ثم would + المصدر. نتحدث عن شيء غير حقيقي الآن، وكثيرًا ما نعطي به نصيحة.
grammar.explanation_en: if + past (with be, use were for all subjects), then would + base verb. We talk about something not real now, often to give advice.
examples: If I were smarter, I would read the whole paper.
If Ezekiel studied, he would be a good student.
If you were taller, you would play basketball.

grammar.title: Will and would
grammar.explanation_ar: will للمضارع/المستقبل، و would هي ماضي will، وكلاهما أفعال ناقصة يتبعها المصدر.
grammar.explanation_en: Will is present/future; would is the past of will. Both are modals followed by the base verb.
examples: He said he would help me.

questions.question: If you study hard, you ___ pass the test.
If I ___ rich, I would buy a big house.
If she were here, she ___ help us.
Which sentence is imaginary (not real)?
choices: If it rains, I will stay home.
If you call me, I will answer.
If he comes, we will start.
If I were a bird, I would fly.

questions.question: Choose the correct sentence (correct grammar).
choices: If he were taller, he would play basketball.
If he will be taller, he would play basketball.
If he were taller, he will play basketball.
If he is taller, he would played basketball.

questions.question: "Would" is the past form of ___.
questions.explanation_en: Would is the past of will.

questions.question: Give advice: "If I ___ you, I would rest."
questions.explanation_ar: التركيب الصحيح: If I were you.

questions.question: If he ___, he will be a good student.
questions.explanation_ar: مع will نستخدم المضارع بعد if.
questions.explanation_en: With will, use present after if.
